title: Data & AI Product Owner
description:
DATA & AI PRODUCT OWNER

London (Hybrid, 3 days per week) | Up to £80,000 + Bonus + Benefits

A fantastic opportunity to join a global professional services organisation investing heavily in Data, AI and digital transformation. You'll play a key role in shaping the future of data and AI products, owning initiatives from discovery through to delivery while working alongside senior stakeholders, data scientists and engineering teams.

The Company

They are a leading international organisation undertaking a significant investment in data and AI capabilities. With a growing specialist team and strong executive sponsorship, they are developing innovative products that support business performance, operational efficiency and decision-making. This is an opportunity to join at an exciting stage and help shape the direction of a newly established Data & AI Product function.

The Role
  • Own Data and AI products throughout the product lifecycle, from idea through to launch and adoption
  • Gather and refine requirements from business stakeholders
  • Define product vision, use cases and priorities
  • Manage and maintain product backlogs
  • Work closely with Data Scientists, Engineers and technical teams during delivery
  • Balance competing stakeholder demands and drive informed prioritisation decisions
  • Shape product roadmaps and influence longer-term strategy
  • Support the successful deployment and adoption of new products across the business
Your Skills & Experience
  • Experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager
  • Strong experience delivering products from discovery through to launch
  • Proven stakeholder management and requirements gathering skills
  • Experience owning and prioritising product backlogs
  • Exposure to Data, Analytics or AI products
  • Comfortable working alongside Data Science and Engineering teams
  • Experience within professional services, consulting, financial services or other complex business environments is advantageous
  • Understanding of modern data platforms and AI use cases is beneficial
What They Offer
  • Salary up to £80,000
  • Discretionary bonus
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Significant ownership and autonomy
  • Clear progression opportunities within a growing Data & AI function
  • Exposure to innovative AI and data initiatives with organisation-wide impact
How to Apply

If you're a Product Owner looking to take ownership of impactful Data and AI products within a highly visible transformation programme, please apply below to learn more.
